Class GameThread

Namespace: osu.Framework.Threading
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A conceptual thread used for running game work. May or may not be backed by a native thread.

Thread

The current dedicated OS thread for this osu.Framework.Threading.GameThread. A value of null does not necessarily mean that this thread is not running; in osu.Framework.Platform.ExecutionMode.SingleThread execution mode osu.Framework.Platform.ThreadRunner drives its osu.Framework.Threading.GameThreads manually and sequentially on the main OS thread of the game process.

public Thread? Thread { get; }

Exit()

Request that this thread is exited.

public void Exit()

Remarks

This does not block and will only queue an exit request, which is processed in the main frame loop.

OnSuspended()

Called when a osu.Framework.Threading.GameThread.Pause or osu.Framework.Threading.GameThread.Exit is requested on this osu.Framework.Threading.GameThread. Use this method to release exclusive resources that the thread could have been holding in its current execution mode, like GL contexts or similar.
